text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I will never look back— 
My eyes are fixed solely on the next 
battle!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...No. I simply despise my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I cannot face the Club. 
And should that happen, I could never 
forgive myself...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I must regroup. Never again 
will I display such a pathetic sight...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have burdened you as well. 
...Will you still stand by someone like 
me?
choice_data_list: I won't be holding back either, though.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then, to reforge ourselves— 
shall we begin with some swordsmanship 
practice?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Let us calm our minds and reflect. 
On where we stand, and on what must be 
done.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then I ask of you: spare no rigor in our 
training. 
So that next time, victory shall surely be 
ours.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So that a strong and beautiful flower, 
worthy of the Club, 
may blossom into full glory—!
